libxml2 2.13.8 (https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/libxml2), used under the MIT
licence (Copyright).  Source: the release tarball libxml2-2.13.8.tar.xz from
download.gnome.org.  Kept: Copyright, README.md, libxml.h, timsort.h,
include/libxml/*.h, include/private/*.h and the sources msxml6.dll needs
(SAX2 buf chvalid dict encoding entities error globals hash list parser
parserInternals threads tree uri valid xmlIO xmlmemory xmlsave xmlstring
xpath).  No source file is changed.

include/libxml/xmlversion.h is generated from the tarball's xmlversion.h.in
with threads, tree, output, push, valid, xpath and ISO-8859-x enabled and
everything else off.  msxml6.dll (userland/msxml6) builds it with the
config.h and Windows headers in userland/msxml6/libxml.
